fields.title: Mortar
fields.description: A small website framework on Solid 2: bricks, collections and a live-preview admin.

data.heading: Build sites from bricks
data.intro: Mortar is a small website framework on Solid 2. Define your sections and collections in code, and get pages rendered on the server and an admin with a live preview.

items.title: Bricks
items.text: Sections as Solid components with a typed schema. The admin builds their forms for you.

items.title: Collections
items.text: Pages, posts, products: documents with typed fields and a body of bricks.

items.title: The admin
items.text: A schema-driven editor whose preview is your real site, with your own layouts and styles.

items.title: Storage you can swap
items.text: JSON files by default. Write a store in four methods; this site keeps your edits in session storage.

items.title: API reference
items.text: Every export, generated from the packages' TypeScript sources.

items.title: Try it here
items.text: Open the admin and change anything on this site. Only you see it, and you can reset it.
